verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṁ vanasaṇḍe.
verses.english: At one time one of the mendicants was staying in the land of the Kosalans in a certain forest grove.

verses.pali: Atha kho tasmiṁ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā tassa bhikkhuno santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: The deity haunting that forest approached that mendicant and spoke this verse in their presence:
when the birds have settled down,
that strikes me as so scary!”
when the birds have settled down,
that strikes me as so delightful!”
